title: Same counterparty, different enforceable netting sets
prompt: Trade marks are USD million from the fund's perspective: positive means receivable. A1 and A2 face counterparty A but are distinct non-nettable legal sets; B1 faces B. Within each set, all listed marks net. Collateral is cash held by the fund, allocated only to its listed set, cannot be transferred and gives no additional receivable when it exceeds a set's net mark. Exposure of a set is floored at zero. Return gross positive trade marks, total unsecured exposure and exposure by counterparty[A,B].

outputs.name: total_ead
outputs.description: Sum of positive unsecured set exposures.
